text:
michael: Deploybot flagged a noisy regression on /v1/generate, suggested auto-revert. p95 spike + errors. anyone looking?
deploybot: AUTOREVERT_TRIGGER: route=/v1/generate, p95>350ms for 5m, error_rate>3% -> suggested action: autorevert to model redwood-model-3.4.0
sara: seeing the same in traces. correlates with kvcache+quantized kernel path on Ampere nodes.
jon: change window ends in ~18m. we can either let deploybot auto-revert or do manual to control comms. :thinking_face:
ops_lead: prefer manual unless it looks like a hard outage. give 10m triage, prepare rollback checklist in parallel. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
michael: +1. if manual, release notes and customer comms need a line. @release_manager can you standby?
release_manager: standing by. I have the original release blurb; will draft rollback blurb if we decide to proceed. Also need to coordinate Dedicated customer notifications.
sara: root cause hypothesis: kernel-selection fallback hits an untested quantized kernel on latest runtime. quick repro in staging.
jon: can we pin traffic regionally as a mitigation? e.g., EU -> previous model while we triage US?
deploybot: PIN_CREATED: route=eu-hosted -> model=redwood-model-3.4.0 @ 95% by jon at 5001234578 (automated log)
ops_lead: good partial mitigation. still prepare global manual rollback plan in case it spreads.
michael: decision time in 8m. if p95 remains >350ms we manual rollback global. who will execute?
sara: sara + jon will take exec. I'll run the rollback commands and watch metrics.
jon: I'll coordinate pins and traffic split. I'll also hold the deploy window flag to prevent auto re-deploys.
release_manager: drafting release note now: "Rollback redwood-model-3.4.1 -> 3.4.0 due to latency regression affecting Ampere-backed hosts." Will add estimated impact and cust-facing blurb.
ops_lead: checklist for manual rollback: 1) post short heads-up in #customer-facing 2) run rollback commands 3) pin model versions 4) monitor 10m canary 5) update status page if needed
sara: running commands now:```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/inference-runtime --image=runtime:v3.4.0
deploybot pin --route global --model redwood-model-3.4.0 --reason "rollback latency regression"
```
jon: watching CI and infra. I'll hold traffic at edge for 3m during cutover.
deploybot: MANUAL_ROLLBACK_STARTED by sara at 5001234582 -> state=initiated
eng_oncall: I'll watch p95 and error rate on the alerts channel. setting a temporary alert throttle to avoid noise.
sara: rollback applied. giving it 2m to stabilize before canary metrics.
eng_oncall: metrics: p95 trending down, error rate normalizing. will post numbers in 3m. :white_check_mark:
deploybot: MANUAL_ROLLBACK_COMPLETED by sara at 5001234589 -> status=success
release_manager: rollout note updated and posted to #customer-facing and support playbook. scheduling brief email to impacted Dedicated customers in 5.
michael: thanks everyone. follow-ups: 1) add e2e for kernel fallback on Ampere 2) add an auto-suppress rule so deploybot won't autorevert during low-signal windows 3) postmortem ticket RN-3587 assigned to sara + jon.
ops_lead: filing the ticket and tagging stakeholders. good job on quick coordination. :thumbsup:
jon: pushing hotfix branch now; will open PR for kernel selector guard.
sara: will run a targeted canary of the patched runtime after PR.
michael: closing thread. keep me posted if anything regresses.
